scope: Non-neural melodic matching precedents. matchers.py implements declared simplified benchmark variants, not exact paper reproductions. Scores are not calibrated probabilities.

papers.title: Comparison of Musical Sequences
papers.precedent: Musical edit operations including insertion, deletion, replacement, consolidation and fragmentation, using pitch and duration.
papers.implementation_boundary: pc_edit and interval_edit use ordinary unit-cost Levenshtein with fixed length normalization. They omit the paper's tonal/duration costs and fragmentation/consolidation; successive signed pitch intervals differ from the paper's tonic-relative pitch representation.

papers.title: Tracking Melodic Patterns in Flamenco Singing by Analyzing Polyphonic Music Recordings
papers.precedent: Dynamic programming for matching symbolic melodic patterns using pitch intervals and durations, with context-dependent time warping.
papers.implementation_boundary: interval_dtw uses conventional three-predecessor DTW, a fixed two-event band, bounded signed-interval/relative-IOI costs, and post-hoc mean-path normalization. It is not the paper's context-dependent DTW.

papers.title: Polyphonic Music Retrieval: The N-Gram Approach
papers.venue: ISMIR 2003 poster; related journal paper Robust Polyphonic Music Retrieval with N-grams, Journal of Intelligent Information Systems 21(1):53-70
papers.precedent: N-note tokens containing n-1 pitch intervals and n-2 onset ratios; polyphonic event extraction, quantization, and BM25/proximity retrieval.
papers.implementation_boundary: interval_ngrams uses monophonic four-note units, exact signed semitone intervals, quarter-log2 IOI-ratio bins, and normalized multiset Dice overlap. It does not reproduce the paper's encoding, polyphonic extraction, or retrieval weighting.

papers.authors: Andreas Arzt, Sebastian Bock and Gerhard Widmer
papers.title: Fast Identification of Piece and Score Position via Symbolic Fingerprinting
papers.precedent: Three absolute-pitch events plus onset-time ratio form tempo-independent fingerprints, with tempo-adjusted position voting.
papers.implementation_boundary: Not implemented in this five-matcher comparison. Original keys contain absolute pitches and are not inherently transposition-invariant.

controls_and_normalization.pc_cosine: Generic order-free pitch-class histogram control; not attributed as a reproduction of one paper.
controls_and_normalization.edit: 1 - unit edit distance / sequence length (9 pitch classes or 8 signed intervals).
controls_and_normalization.dtw: 1 - minimum-sum path cost / that path's length; exact sum-cost ties choose shorter paths; not minimum-average-path DTW.
controls_and_normalization.ngrams: Multiset Dice intersection of six tokens per nine-note window.
controls_and_normalization.causality: All eight inter-onset intervals are complete. Caller must restrict queries and memory to observed onsets, exclude overlapping self-matches, and avoid reference-annotation position labels at inference.
